description: Reads the specified roof snow load for an Ontario city from SB-1 and Article 9.4.2.2., then checks whether a site-built rafter in Tables 9.23.4.2.-F and -G of the 2024 Ontario Building Code can span your roof or whether roof trusses are needed. Source: 2024 Ontario Building Code (O. Reg. 163/24), Division B, Tables 9.23.4.2.-F and 9.23.4.2.-G, Articles 9.4.2.1., 9.4.2.2. and 9.23.14.11.; SB-1 Table 2 (Ss and Sr).

city.description: Ontario city, to read the 1-in-50 year ground snow load Ss and rain load Sr from SB-1 Table 2. Leave empty and give ss_kpa and sr_kpa instead.

narrow_roof.description: Is the entire roof width 4.3 m or less? (Article 9.4.2.2.: basic roof factor Cb 0.45 instead of 0.55.)

pitch.description: Roof pitch as rise per 12 of run, used only to report the sloped rafter length.

spacing_mm.description: Rafter spacing on centre (12, 16 and 24 in are also accepted). Unit: mm.

span_ft.description: Horizontal span between the inside faces of the supports, in feet (or use span_m). Unit: ft.

span_in.description: Extra inches added to span_ft. Unit: in.

span_m.description: Horizontal span in metres, instead of span_ft. Unit: m.

sr_kpa.description: Rain load Sr from SB-1 Table 2, used when city is empty. Unit: kPa.

ss_kpa.description: Ground snow load Ss from SB-1 Table 2, used when city is empty. Unit: kPa.

name: truss_vs_rafter_span_checker
title: Truss vs Rafter Span Checker
